summary: Identified-hadron elliptic flow in oxygen-oxygen collisions and antideuteron-net-Lambda fluctuations provide the strongest experimental results. Methodological advances address QCD speed-of-sound extraction, nonflow subtraction, higher-order strongly intensive observables, uncertainty-aware validation of generative models, interpretable neural PDF fits, and representation diagnostics for jet taggers.
strongest_paper: ALICE identified-hadron v2 in OO (2610.36237) provides the most discriminating evidence of partonic collectivity, using the phi/Lambda contrast to separate baryon-meson structure from a purely mass-driven pattern.

papers.title: Evidence of partonic collectivity in OO collisions through the measurement of phi, K0S, and Lambda elliptic flow
papers.abstract: ALICE measures identified-hadron v2 in OO, observing low-pT mass ordering and a 10-sigma baryon-meson split at intermediate pT; the phi tracks K0S rather than the mass-similar Lambda.

papers.title: Measurement of antideuteron and net-Lambda number fluctuations at the Large Hadron Collider
papers.abstract: The first antideuteron-net-Lambda correlation agrees with statistical hadronization, supporting nucleosynthesis as the origin of the earlier antideuteron-antiproton discrepancy.

papers.title: Extracting the QCD speed of sound in the presence of quantum fluctuations
papers.abstract: A Gaussianity-based framework corrects quantum-fluctuation bias in speed-of-sound extraction and closes against event-by-event hydrodynamic simulations.

papers.title: Improved nonflow control for multiparticle correlators and system-size-dependent evolution from OO to Pb-Pb collisions at the LHC
papers.abstract: A v1-based nonflow scaling method outperforms multiplicity reweighting in toy and PYTHIA-Angantyr closure tests and is applied to AMPT OO predictions.

papers.title: Higher-order strongly intensive observables for forward-backward multiplicity correlations
papers.abstract: An all-order hierarchy removes source-number fluctuations under independent-identical-source assumptions and is benchmarked analytically and with PYTHIA.

papers.title: An end-to-end framework for uncertainty-aware validation of generative models
papers.abstract: SIGMA profiles density-estimator uncertainty in a composite-null goodness-of-fit test, avoiding spurious rejection driven by finite training data.

papers.title: The proton structure one mode at a time: a Neural Tangent Kernel analysis of a DIS fit
papers.abstract: NTK eigenmodes expose how neural PDF fits incrementally learn signal and then noise, providing an interpretable view of regularization.

papers.title: What the Primary Lund Plane Omits: A Model-Stitching Diagnosis of a Jet-Tagger Representation Gap
papers.abstract: Model stitching identifies a representation deficit hidden by AUC; full-tree Lund information closes 72% of the top-tagging rejection gap.

papers.title: Energy density in color string clusters and its implications for heavy-quark energy loss
papers.abstract: Two prescriptions for color-string-cluster energy density lead to different effective temperatures, but no heavy-flavor data comparison is presented.
